scope: Apply xhigh reasoning to every reviewer model across workflows.

instruction_changes.deviation: The default reviewer and Terra had xhigh, but the standing rules did not assign xhigh to every present or future reviewer model.
instruction_changes.evidence: The user explicitly requested a general rule for future reviewer model preferences.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: The shared reviewer preference governs dispatch across workflows and hosts.

user_preference.request: Use xhigh when the user adds any future reviewer model preference.
user_preference.scope: All reviewer models across workflows, including opt-in passes, using a verified provider equivalent when needed.

change_reconciliation.authority: Explicit user request to generalize the xhigh reviewer preference.
change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: Apply the explicit model effort preference within the existing dispatch and verification contract.
change_reconciliation.checks: Canonical rendering, selected recovery bindings, and the artifact-only instruction profile.

outcome_review.expected: Every managed host receives the same reviewer reasoning rule.
outcome_review.observed: The standing source rendered the universal rule into the three managed overlays.
outcome_review.evidence: Canonical generated instruction files and their bound recovery identities.
outcome_review.limitations: These checks establish policy and artifact identity. Availability and effort are verified at dispatch.

obligations.reason: Generalize reviewer effort at its shared owner.
